C01.chart: (x0,r,theta,phi), r>0, 0<theta<pi, phi in a local open interval; dOmega2=dtheta^2+sin(theta)^2 dphi^2
C01.branch: F>0 and positive sqrt; e0 future; u=e0, U=c u
C01.TOV_jet_definitions: ODE mprime=kappa r^2epsilon/2; nuprime=(m+kappa alpha epsilon r^3/2-Lambda r^3/3)/(r^2F); epsilonprime=-(1+alpha)epsilon nuprime/alpha
C01.derivative_reduction: Differentiate the three ODE substitutions as needed, by product and chain rules; do not assume Einstein or curvature conclusions.

C02.index_meaning: Displayed R_abcd are covariant orthonormal-frame components; same curvature sign as COMMON_SPEC
C02.weyl_specialization: Interpret the literal Lambda0 as Lambda=0 (requires explicit adoption); mu=kappa epsilon0/6
C02.derivative_target_candidate: Compute the orthonormal covariant derivative (nabla_e1 Weyl)(e0,e1,e0,e1) at the matched event; verify zero Weyl tensor there and nonzero selected derivative. No derivative answer supplied.

C03.action: Same Pstar>0,q>0,0<alpha<1,s=(1+alpha)/(2alpha); X=-g^(ab)psi_a psi_b/2>0, P=Pstar X^s, psi=q x0, Pstar(q^2/2)^s=p0 fixed
C03.stress_current_definitions_candidate: Derive metric stress variation and scalar Euler-Lagrange current from this action; no stress/current result as input
C03.metric_dependency: Full current statement requires C01 chart/metric admission; scalar derivative algebra alone does not.

C04.quantity_candidate: Physical acceleration magnitude |A| (candidate inference from the adjacent displayed rate, not an admitted interpretation of the unspecified original divergent quantity)
C04.expression_target_candidate: |A|(y)=(c^2 |B|/sqrt(C)) y/sqrt(1-y^2), 0<y<1; proposed target obtained by substituting r0=y/sqrt(C) into the displayed uncontracted acceleration target. This is not an accepted result or execution permission.
C04.family_candidate: Fix c,kappa,alpha,epsilon0,p0,Pstar,q,mu,Lambda and hence B,C; vary r0=y/sqrt(C), m0=mu r0^3; nu0=0 each germ. Approach y->1 from below; no F0=0 member
C04.analytic_boundary: Distinct smooth local germs and existence/persistence are separate analytic obligations.

assumptions: mu,Lambda real; C=2mu+Lambda/3>0; B=mu+kappa p0/2-Lambda/3 nonzero
Each radial jet is evaluated where r>0,F>0,epsilon>0,0<theta<pi; smooth radial functions and prescribed TOV derivatives; no existence theorem assumed

neutral_operations.curvature: Use COMMON_SPEC R^a_bcd sign, R_abcd=g_ae R^e_bcd; Ricci_bd=R^a_bad, Einstein=Ricci-(scalar/2)g. Full coordinate formulas must be computed from metric, not defined from targets.
neutral_operations.stress_definition: S_m=integral sqrt(-det g) P(X) d^4x, T_ab=-(2/sqrt(-det g)) delta S_m/delta g^(ab), metric variation at fixed psi; derive determinant and X variations.
neutral_operations.current_definition: Scalar Euler-Lagrange current from action, J^a=P_X g^(ab) partial_b psi up to irrelevant overall sign; divergence computed from metric connection or sqrt(-det g) formula.
neutral_operations.sound_ratio: The finite action derivative ratio c_s^2/c^2=P_X/(P_X+2X P_XX); this alone is not a proof of physical hyperbolicity/UV stability.

analytic_obligations_not_assumptions: Local smooth ODE existence on r>0,F>0,epsilon>0
Strict DEC persistence and normal-coordinate 2-jet theorem
Divergence limit corresponds to distinct smooth local germs
